data.title: Excise duties (honest minimal pack) — sweetened beverages ₦10/litre; telecom 5% suspended then abolished

provenance.as_passed: Finance Act 2021 (excise on sweetened non-alcoholic beverages, ₦10/litre); Finance Act 2020 (5% excise on telecom services); presidential suspension 2023; abolition announced 19 Aug 2025
provenance.source_citation: Finance Act 2021 s.52 (sweetened beverage excise); Orbitax "Nigeria Abolishes 5% Excise Tax on Telecommunication Services" (https://orbitax.com/news/country/article/Nigeria-Abolishes-5-Excise-Ta-59705); PwC Nigeria tax summaries (excise/excise-like levies)
